conf.description: Workspace ONE UEM console audit events, syslog-kv: same admin-authored Message Content template as device-events, filtered to EventType=Console, mapped to ECS.

conf.comment: console-events/syslog-kv, shares the syslog listener and template with device-events; this pipeline keeps Console only. The vendor lookup 'Request Url' contains a literal space, so kvp extraction of 'Request Url=...' yields a stray empty 'Request' token and a real 'Url' key holding the value - this pipeline reads 'Url' directly and never references the space-bearing name. Query string stripped from url.original (can carry session tokens). MessageText/LogDescription coalesced into message per catalog note; Severity mapped to an inline low/medium/high numeric scale (Information=1, Warning=5, Critical=10) since no ECS numeric convention was specified. EventTimestamp has no UTC offset in the template - see README gap, same as device-events.

functions.description: pipeline purpose, routing key, and documented gaps
Message body: a Cribl Syslog Source leaves the full line, header included, in _raw and the body in message; anything else carries the body in _raw.
extract the admin-authored key=value Message Content fields
this pipeline serves console-events only; Device records belong to the device-events pipeline on the same syslog listener
map every field to its ECS/custom target, derive outcome/category/severity, strip url query string, remove raw duplicates
rename the remaining strictly 1:1 mapped fields
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
